senses.gloss:
Lascivious,Ⓒa.ⒹkAmuka, kAmin, ratArTin, kAmAsakta, ratisuKAsakta, BogAsakta, laMpawa, strIlaMpawa, kAmapravaRa; See Lustful.
Ⓑ
 2 kAma-hetuka, kAmamUlaka.
Ⓝ[Lascivious]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹkAmukavat, laMpawavat, BogAsaktyA.
Ⓝ[Lascivious]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹkAmukatvaM, BogAsakti f., ratAsaktiH, vyavAyecCA, lAMpawyaM.

Lash,Ⓒs.ⒹkaSA, pratizkaSaH-zaH, carmarajju f., carmabaMDaH.
Ⓑ
 2 kaSAGAtaH-tAqanaM-prahAraH.
Ⓑ
 3 vAgasiH, paruzavacanaM.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹkaSayA Ahan 2 U or taq 10 or prahf 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 vi-DU 5, 9 U, 6 P, vical c., itastataH kzip 6 P or cal c.
Ⓑ
 3 vAgbAREH Bid 7 P or taq, vAgasinA prahf; tIkzRaM niMd 1 P; ‘l(ash)ed into fury’ vAgbAREH uttejitakroDaH; SilAtalapratiGAto-tpatanaPenilAnAmapAM (Ka. 133); ‘l(ash)ed into foam by striking’ &c. jarjarita-jalataraMgavitatanIhAraM (Mal. 9) ‘so as to l(ash) the water into snowy foam’.
Ⓑ
 4 rajjvA baMD 9 P; ‘worthy of being l(ash)ed’ kaSya, kaSArha.
Lassitude,Ⓒs.ⒹKedaH, klamaH, glAni f.; See Languidness.

Last,Ⓒa.ⒹaMtya, aMtima, avara, avatarama, carama, paScima; Seza-aMta- in comp.
Ⓑ
 2 gata, atIta, carama, pUrva, BUta.
Ⓑ
 3 jaGanya, aDama, apakfzwa.
Ⓑ
 4 [] parama, uttama, atyaMta; ‘l(ast) night’ gatAyAM rAtrO; ‘the l(ast) year’ gata-atIta-saMvatsaraH, parut ind.; ‘l(ast) but one’ upAMtya, upAMtika; ‘l(ast)-born’ avaraja; ‘at l(ast)’ ate, aMtataH; ‘l(ast) part’ SezaBAgaH; ‘l(ast) part of the night’ uttararAtraH, caramayAmaH; ‘l(ast) half’ uttarArDaH, paScArDaH, parArDaH, ‘the year before l(ast)’ parAri ind.; ‘to the l(ast)’ SezaM yAvat.
Ⓔadv.ⒹaMte, Seze, aMtataH, avaraM, caramaM, avarataH.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹavasTA 1 A, sTA 1 P; oft. by avaDiH in comp.; ‘l(ast)ing for many days’ cirasTAyin, eza te jI-vitAvaDiH pravAdaH (U. 1) ‘will l(ast) through life’; ‘this will l(ast) as food for four months’ etena (asmAkaM) mAsacatuzwayasya BojanaM Bavizyati; ‘the bloom of youth l(ast)s for a few days’ katipayadivasasTAyinI yOvanaSrIH (Bh. ii. 2).
Ⓝ[Last]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹsTAyin, cira-dIrGa-kAlasTAyin; anapAyin, nitya, sTira, Druva, akzaya, SASvata (tI f.), ajara, ciraMtana (nI f.).
Ⓝ[Last]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹaMte, aMtataH, caramataH, Seze, avarataH.
Lazar,Ⓒs.ⒹkuzWin m., Svitrin m., koWo-pahataH, tvagrogopahataH; ‘l(azar)-house’ kuzWi-SAlA, SvitryAlayaH.

Lazy,Ⓒa.Ⓓalasa, taMdrila, jaqa, maMda, maMTara, taM-drAlu, maMdagati, AlasyaSIla, anudyogin, udyogavimuKa (KI f.), avyavasAyaSIla; SItaka, anuzRa, tuMdaparimfja.
Ⓝ[Lazi]ly,Ⓒadv.Ⓓalasavat, jaqavat, maMdaM maMdaM, jAqyena.
Ⓝ[Lazy]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹAlasyaM, mAMdyaM, jAqyaM, jaqatA, taMdrikA, taM-drAlutA, kAryadvezaH, anudyogaSIlatA, utsAha-vimuKatA, alasaSIlatA.
